images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of ActionPiece.Physical action distance (defined in Section4.2) combines normalized translation, shortest-path rotation onSO⁡(3)\mathrm{SO}(3), and gripper differences to select anchor, near, and far action chunks within a training batch. The tokenizer compresses each eight-step chunk into 16 discrete tokens and reconstructs executable actions. Alongside reconstruction, physical rank preservation (PRP, defined in Section4.3) encourages the near–far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization (QR, defined in Section4.4) encourages the same ordering in the Jensen–Shannon divergence between codeword assignment distributions. HereL2L_{2}denotes the slot-averaged squared distance between normalized features.
